metadata.name: DISFOR retrospective clear-cut pilot
metadata.label_provenance: DISFOR high-confidence human-interpreted segments; auxiliary sources in sample manifest; not newly collected field ground truth
metadata.group_definition: Connected components within 5 km plus same source damage polygon/storm; all years of a point kept together. Sampling strata excluded from event union.
metadata.temporal_alignment: Two full calendar years; event must be in second year, intact forest in preceding year; negatives intact entire window; no event dates in features
metadata.units: Source-provided DN, no added offset; per-channel standardization fitted on training only
metadata.task: Retrospective classification of selected 24-month windows, not early warning or continuous map validation
metadata.monthly_quality: Median of source clear AND SCL 4/5; at least 6 valid months in each year. Missing months remain missing.

config.note: Validation labels are additional to the stated TRAINING label budget; std is seed variability, not a confidence interval.
